description: Ministry of Justice - Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act No. 25 of 2022 - Order under Section 2
reasoning: This gazette content is an order under Section 2 of the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No. 25 of 2002, declaring that the provisions of the Act apply to BIMSTEC Convention countries. It establishes a legal framework for international cooperation in criminal matters, including terrorism, organized crime, drug trafficking, money laundering, and cybercrimes. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments, legal declarations, and regulatory frameworks for international legal cooperation.
